form.description: The Northern Eurasia Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence is an international AI olympiad for high-school students from Northern Eurasia and partner countries. The competition uses a practice-oriented format with challenges in areas including machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, data analysis, and algorithmic thinking. Participants from Russia compete onsite at the official venue, while international participants can compete remotely or at local partner venues.

form.title: Northern Eurasia Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence 2026

form.description: The 2026 Asia Pacific Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence (APOAI), a regional artificial intelligence olympiad operating under the supervision of the International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence.
